facts.statement: Derive World is an open-source foundation for Living Objects: shared, versioned objects that people and their Personal AI can read, contribute to, derive from, and trace through an explicit lineage.

sources.contains: Derive World is an open-source foundation

facts.statement: A Personal AI can propose changes and derive children, but only a human can approve; a derived world is an independent child from an immutable snapshot.

sources.contains: independent child from an immutable snapshot

facts.statement: Derive creates an independent child from an immutable snapshot of the source; later edits to the parent do not propagate and the ancestry is recorded.
The project is licensed under Apache-2.0.
Fixture mode is a deterministic demo: it calls no model and is not real AI.
